environment.description: Application deployed on a single EC2 instance (t3.medium) running Amazon Linux 2, behind an NLB (Network Load Balancer) with TCP passthrough on port 443. Security group allows inbound 443 from 0.0.0.0/0. SQLite database stored on local EBS volume. Flask running via gunicorn with 4 workers. No additional middleware or proxy layers. Instance profile has no special permissions.

config.load_balancer: NLB with TCP listener on 443, target group health check on /health
config.database: SQLite on local EBS gp3 volume
